changes: v2.17.156 (REBUILT 2026-09-22 with the PBR materials work; the original .156 asset carried only the tap fix)

MATERIALS: metalness, roughness, normal map and ambient occlusion are now stamped on every material LEXOLA creates, resolved from materials/pbr_families.json by category/brand/range/id - so they never have to be set by hand again

FIXED: metal was classified by the material's DISPLAY NAME, so 24 non-metals exported as fully metallic - 17 RAL paints (Jet Black, Zinc Yellow, Pearl Gold, Steel Blue, Chrome Green...), 6 granites (Absolute Black, Black Pearl, Silver Forest...) and the basic Black. A black paint at metalness 1 renders nearly pure black. RAL 9006/9007 stay metallic: they really are aluminium-flake paint
SketchUp and the GLB export now read the SAME table, so a unit and its render cannot disagree
414 generated normal/roughness/AO maps ship with the textures; maps with no variation are deliberately omitted rather than shipped as blank filler
Alu Sandwich (Larcore A2) gains a real texture - 2048px over a 2000x2000mm tile - and Tricoya's tile is raised 0.27m -> 2.0m, so neither repeats visibly on a panel

verified: 8/8 materials carry their table values live with a negative control that correctly fails; golden baseline parts/AABB unchanged (LBU 140, LBQ 136, LHU 163); notch rule 4 pass 0 FAIL; archive 912 entries, all discriminators present, byte-equal to src, leak-clean, 0 macOS blockers
